basic_info.description: Discover unparalleled luxury in St. Regis Residence 22C, a designer-appointed two-bedroom, two-bath sanctuary spanning 1,723 square feet with a unique layout in the complex. Boasting unobstructed western views of San Francisco's city lights and Twin Peaks, this exceptional residence features owner-driven improvements throughout including Lutron Triathalon wireless shades. The kitchen elevates culinary experiences with custom quartzite counters, additional shelving, a full-size wine refrigerator, and top-tier appliances. The primary suite provides an ultimate retreat, complete with built-in surround sound, a spa-inspired marble-clad bathroom, and a spacious walk-in closet. Residents enjoy five-star St. Regis amenities including 24/7 room service, a fitness center, a newly renovated lap pool, landscaped owner's terrace with cabanas, personalized concierge and butler services, world-class security, and valet parking. Strategically located in San Francisco's Arts District adjacent to SFMOMA, the residence offers convenient proximity to Union Square, the Financial District, and the Embarcadero, creating an unparalleled urban living experience.
